text.title: Feed Yourself
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_mood: Witty, weary, hopeful, culturally skeptical → warm, curious, gently defiant
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive busker groove, lo-fi hip-hop drums, brushed snare, palm taps, warm upright bass, sparse piano after second hook, room hiss, live imperfect feel, sharp dropouts before punchlines, final third adds soft harmonies while staying raw
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male close-mic vocal, spoken-word rap verses with dry comic timing and clipped pauses, half-sung folk hook, starts sardonic and observant, grows open and grateful, slight rasp on punchlines, whispered doubles on key phrases, final hook warmer and more communal
